name_ar: منهجية مؤشرات S&P الشرعية — S&P Dow Jones Indices (مسودة معطّلة، غير مشفّرة)
name_en: S&P Shariah Indices Methodology — S&P Dow Jones Indices (DRAFT, disabled, not encoded)
pin_requirements: The current S&P Shariah Indices Methodology document (S&P Dow Jones Indices, spglobal.com): the sector-based screen list; the accounting-based screens with exact thresholds, comparison direction, averaging window and denominator definitions; the current status of the accounts-receivable screen after the 2026-09-21 revision; and the methodology's dividend purification treatment.
reason_ar: بوابة التثبيت في الإيشو #169: لا تُشفّر الأرقام إلا من وثيقة منهجية S&P DJI الحالية نفسها. تلك الوثيقة منشورة على spglobal.com ولم يمكن جلبها من بيئة البناء (الوصول محظور)، والمنهجية تغيرت جوهريًا في 2026-09-21 (خُفض حدا الدين والنقد من 33% إلى 30%)، فالنسخ الأقدم والملخصات الثانوية لا تثبّت القواعد الحالية، والملخصات الثانوية متعارضة بشأن بقاء فحص الذمم المدينة بعد المراجعة. هذا الملف يوثق حالة المسودة فقط؛ لا يحتوي أي نسب مشفرة والمحرك لا يحمّله.
reason_en: Issue #169 pin gate: figures may be encoded only from S&P DJI's own current methodology document. That document is published on spglobal.com, which could not be fetched from the build environment (access blocked), and the methodology changed materially on 2026-09-21 (the debt and cash limits were lowered from 33% to 30%), so older copies and secondary summaries cannot pin the current rulebook; secondaries also conflict on whether the accounts-receivable screen survives the revision. This file records the draft status only: it contains no encoded ratios and the engine does not load it.
secondary_reports_unpinned: Multiple secondary summaries agree that from 2026-09-21 the debt limit and the cash + interest-bearing securities limit are each 30% of the trailing 36-month average market value (lowered from 33%), per S&P DJI's announcement of 2026-08-20 aligning the indices with the S&P Shariah Supervisory Board's opinion.

Pre-revision secondary summaries list an accounts-receivable screen below 49% of the same 36-month base; one current secondary table marks that 49% as the 'pre-change rule' and another current summary lists only two financial ratios for the revised methodology. Whether the receivables screen survives, and at what figure, is exactly what the pin must settle.

Pre-revision secondary summaries agree the business-activity tolerance is non-permissible revenue below 5%, and that the S&P Shariah sector screen does not exclude defence/weapons (unlike MSCI, FTSE and DJIM).
